title: Coca-Cola vs Pepsi
shortAnswer: Coca-Cola leads global market share with a 43% share of the carbonated soft drink market vs Pepsi's 25%. Pepsi (PepsiCo) has a more diversified portfolio including Frito-Lay snacks, making PepsiCo's total revenue larger.
verdict: Coca-Cola wins the cola war. PepsiCo wins in total food & beverage diversification. Both are iconic American brands.

youtubeTitle: Coca-Cola vs Pepsi: Who Actually Won the Cola War?
youtubeDescription:
Coca-Cola holds 43% of the carbonated soft drink market against Pepsi's 25%, and ranks sixth globally in brand value versus Pepsi's 36th. But PepsiCo pulls in $91 billion in revenue against Coke's $45 billion thanks to Frito-Lay and its wider food portfolio. We break down market share, revenue, brand value and global reach to settle it.

Figures accurate as of October 2026. Statistics change over time — see the full, maintained comparison at https://www.aversusb.net/compare/coca-cola-vs-pepsi
